OutCycling Weekend Training Series

New York, NY · Road

LGBTQ+

OutCycling Weekend Training Series is a road group ride in New York, NY. Schedule: Saturdays in two blocks: a spring series and a fall series (fall 2026: seven weekends, Sep 19 – Nov 7). About 40–85 miles, recreational 12–16 mph with a sweep; Advanced 16–20 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12–16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @outcyclingny the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the OutCycling Weekend Training Series group ride

OutCycling is New York's LGBTQ+ cycling club. The training series builds distance week by week, with a lead and a sweep on every ride. Routes head to Westchester, New Jersey and Connecticut, with bakery and orchard stops. Sign-up is through the club's Spond group.
